semantic_change.counterfactual_counterevidence_test: Counterevidence is admissible only when, if true, it makes the exact claim materially less likely, less strong, or less economically valid.
semantic_change.coexistence_rule: Evidence fully compatible with the exact claim is not counterevidence merely because it challenges a downstream inference, broader moat mechanism, or another scoped event.
semantic_change.descriptive_vs_inferential_rule: When opposition targets an economic inference rather than a raw observation, frame the finding at the economically contestable inferential level or leave counterevidence empty for the descriptive claim.
semantic_change.mixed_rule: MIXED requires support and opposition to bear on the same semantic target.
semantic_change.scope_rule: A conflict resolved by scope does not create MIXED unless residual evidence still weakens the exact claim after the scope distinction.

regression_targets: Low reported churn may remain a descriptive claim only if multi-sourcing / volume-shifting evidence is not misclassified as counterevidence to the low-churn observation.
Switching-friction findings may use multi-sourcing / volume-shifting evidence as counterevidence when the claim itself is framed at the switching-friction inference level.
A documented service incident must not be made MIXED solely by high availability during another scoped event.
E-040 remains SUPPORT with qualification when selected enterprise wins do not quantify revenue contribution.
Issuer-hosted or selected supportive evidence may remain SUPPORT with explicit qualification rather than being mislabeled COUNTEREVIDENCE.
weak_link_candidates.candidate short labels remain valid without terminal punctuation.

cost_guard.interpretation: The v1.0 claim-target-alignment prompt adds only modest input overhead while preserving the common 4096-token output envelope.
